clips.title: The story
paras: Blackrock orcs hold Render's Rock above Redridge, near the pass to the Burning Steppes. From this cave, they prepare attacks on the valleys below.

North of Lakeshire, Blackrock orcs guard a cave cut into the Redridge heights. The stronghold lies near the mountain pass leading to the Burning Steppes, where veteran orcs direct attacks against Redridge's defenders. Their guards make any attempt to enter perilous, whether to disrupt the orcs' supply lines or recover captives lost in the fighting.
